tool_schemas.name: create_page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion page under the specified parent (page, database, or workspace) using the selected integration, optionally setting title/properties/icon/cover and creating initial child blocks; returns the created Notion page object as mirrored locally. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parent_type is invalid, if parent_notion_id is missing when parent_type is page/database, or if provided Notion payload shapes are not objects/arrays as required; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot write to the target parent, NOT_FOUND if the specified parent does not exist or is not shared with the integration, and RATE_LIMITED if Notion or this service rejects the request due to quota.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request.

parent_type.description: Type of parent container where the page will be created.

parent_notion_id.description: Notion id of the parent page/database (required when parent_type is page or database).

title.description: Plain text title for the new page.

properties.description: Notion page properties payload to set on creation (Notion API shape).

icon.description: Notion icon object to set on the page (Notion API shape).

cover.description: Notion cover object to set on the page (Notion API shape).

content_blocks.description: Optional list of Notion block objects to create as children of the new page.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_page(integration_id, parent_type, parent_notion_id=None, title=None, properties=None, icon=None, cover=None, content_blocks=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, uuid, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0066000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0066000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()

    integrations = _load("integrations.json")
    pages = _load("pages.json")
    blocks = _load("blocks.json")
    reqlogs = _load("request_logs.json")
    todos = _load("todos.json")

    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        # stable-ish unique id
        return f"{prefix}_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"

    def _log(success, notion_endpoint=None, notion_http_status=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, payload=None):
        rid = _new_id("nia_rlg")
        dur = int(max(0, (time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        reqlogs.append({
            "id": rid,
            "integration_id": integration_id if isinstance(integration_id, str) else "",
            "tool_name": "create_page",
            "request_payload": payload,
            "notion_endpoint": notion_endpoint,
            "notion_http_status": notion_http_status,
            "success": bool(success),
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": dur,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", reqlogs)

    def _rate_limit_check():
        # Simple local rate limiting: 3 req/sec per integration, bursty window 1s
        cutoff = datetime.datetime.utcnow() - datetime.timedelta(seconds=1)
        cnt = 0
        for r in reqlogs:
            if r.get("integration_id") != integration_id:
                continue
            ts = r.get("created_at")
            if not isinstance(ts, str):
                continue
            try:
                dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z", "+00:00")).replace(tzinfo=None)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if dt >= cutoff:
                cnt += 1
        if cnt >= 3:
            return False
        return True

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(integration_id, str) or not re.match(r"^nia_int_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{17,}$", integration_id):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", notion_http_status=None, error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="integration_id is missing or invalid",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "integration_id is missing or invalid")

    if not isinstance(parent_type, str) or parent_type not in ("page", "database", "workspace"):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="parent_type must be one of: page, database, workspace",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parent_type must be one of: page, database, workspace")

    if parent_type in ("page", "database"):
        if not isinstance(parent_notion_id, str) or not parent_notion_id.strip():
            _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
                 error_message="parent_notion_id is required when parent_type is page or database",
                 payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parent_notion_id is required when parent_type is page or database")

    if title is not None and not isinstance(title, str):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="title must be a string",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title must be a string")

    if properties is not None and not isinstance(properties, dict):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="properties must be an object",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "properties must be an object")

    if icon is not None and not isinstance(icon, dict):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="icon must be an object",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "icon must be an object")

    if cover is not None and not isinstance(cover, dict):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="cover must be an object",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "cover must be an object")

    if content_blocks is not None:
        if not isinstance(content_blocks, list) or any(not isinstance(b, dict) for b in content_blocks):
            _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
                 error_message="content_blocks must be an array of objects",
                 payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "content_blocks must be an array of objects")

    # Resolve integration
    integ = next((i for i in integrations if i.get("id") == integration_id), None)
    if not integ:
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", notion_http_status=401, error_code="UNAUTHORIZED",
             error_message="Unknown integration_id",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Unknown integration_id")

    # Mutating tools rejected when disabled/revoked
    if integ.get("status") in ("disabled", "revoked"):
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", notion_http_status=401, error_code="UNAUTHORIZED",
             error_message="Integration is disabled or revoked",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Integration is disabled or revoked")

    # Rate limit
    if not _rate_limit_check():
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", notion_http_status=429, error_code="RATE_LIMIT",
             error_message="Rate limited",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limited", retry_after_ms=1000)

    # "Create" in offline server: emulate Notion page object and persist mirror.
    # Idempotency: if caller provides a deterministic unique property it's unknown; enforce uniqueness on notion_page_id only.
    notion_page_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    # Ensure uniqueness (integration_id, notion_page_id)
    if any(p.get("integration_id") == integration_id and p.get("notion_page_id") == notion_page_id for p in pages):
        # extremely unlikely; regenerate a few times
        for _ in range(3):
            notion_page_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            if not any(p.get("integration_id") == integration_id and p.get("notion_page_id") == notion_page_id for p in pages):
                break
        else:
            _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", notion_http_status=409, error_code="CONFLICT",
                 error_message="Could not generate unique notion_page_id",
                 payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Could not generate unique notion_page_id")

    # Construct properties payload if absent; best-effort include title
    props = properties.copy() if isinstance(properties, dict) else {}
    if title is not None and "title" not in props:
        # Notion title schema is database-specific; keep a minimal normalized representation
        props["title"] = {"type": "title", "title": [{"type": "text", "text": {"content": title}}]}

    page_row = {
        "id": _new_id("nia_pag"),
        "integration_id": integration_id,
        "notion_page_id": notion_page_id,
        "parent_type": parent_type,
        "parent_notion_id": parent_notion_id if parent_type != "workspace" else None,
        "in_database_notion_id": parent_notion_id if parent_type == "database" else None,
        "title_plaintext": title if isinstance(title, str) and title.strip() else None,
        "icon": icon,
        "cover": cover,
        "properties": props if isinstance(props, dict) else {},
        "archived": False,
        "status": "active",
        "notion_created_time": now,
        "notion_last_edited_time": now,
        "last_synced_at": now,
        "last_sync_error": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now
    }

    # pages constraints: parent_type != workspace implies parent_notion_id not null
    if page_row["parent_type"] != "workspace" and not page_row["parent_notion_id"]:
        _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
             error_message="parent_notion_id must be provided when parent_type is not workspace",
             payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parent_notion_id must be provided when parent_type is not workspace")

    pages.append(page_row)

    # Create child blocks mirror if requested
    created_block_rows = []
    if isinstance(content_blocks, list) and content_blocks:
        pos = 0
        for blk in content_blocks:
            # Determine a type; allow unknown
            btype = blk.get("type")
            allowed = {
                "paragraph", "heading_1", "heading_2", "heading_3", "bulleted_list_item", "numbered_list_item",
                "to_do", "toggle", "quote", "code", "callout", "divider", "image", "video", "file", "bookmark",
                "embed", "equation", "table", "table_row", "child_page", "child_database", "synced_block",
                "column_list", "column", "link_to_page", "breadcrumb", "table_of_contents", "unsupported", "unknown"
            }
            if not isinstance(btype, str) or btype not in allowed:
                btype = "unknown"

            nbid = str(uuid.uuid4())
            if any(b.get("integration_id") == integration_id and b.get("notion_block_id") == nbid for b in blocks):
                nbid = str(uuid.uuid4())

            brow = {
                "id": _new_id("nia_blk"),
                "integration_id": integration_id,
                "notion_block_id": nbid,
                "root_page_id": page_row["id"],
                "parent_block_id": None,
                "parent_notion_block_id": page_row["notion_page_id"],  # using page id as parent notion id surrogate
                "block_type": btype,
                "has_children": bool(blk.get("has_children")) if isinstance(blk.get("has_children"), bool) else False,
                "position_index": pos,
                "content": blk,
                "archived": False,
                "status": "active",
                "notion_created_time": now,
                "notion_last_edited_time": now,
                "last_synced_at": now,
                "last_sync_error": None,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            }
            # constraints: position_index null OR >=0, parent_block_id null OR root_page_id not null
            if brow["position_index"] is not None and (not isinstance(brow["position_index"], int) or brow["position_index"] < 0):
                _log(False, notion_endpoint="/v1/blocks/children", error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR",
                     error_message="position_index must be >= 0",
                     payload={"integration_id": integration_id})
                return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "position_index must be >= 0")
            blocks.append(brow)
            created_block_rows.append(brow)
            pos += 1

    # Persist
    _save("pages.json", pages)
    _save("blocks.json", blocks)

    notion_page_obj = {
        "object": "page",
        "id": notion_page_id,
        "created_time": now,
        "last_edited_time": now,
        "archived": False,
        "parent": {"type": parent_type, parent_type: {"id": parent_notion_id}} if parent_type in ("page", "database") else {"type": "workspace", "workspace": True},
        "properties": page_row["properties"],
        "icon": icon,
        "cover": cover
    }

    _log(True, notion_endpoint="/v1/pages", notion_http_status=200, payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_type": parent_type})

    return {
        "page": notion_page_obj,
        "mirror": page_row,
        "created_blocks": created_block_rows,
        "request": {"integration_id": integration_id}
    }

tool_schemas.name: get_page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a Notion page by notion_page_id using the given integration and returns the page object (and updates/uses the local mirror for that page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if notion_page_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration does not have access to the page, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not shared with the integration, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream or service quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request.

tool_schemas.name: update_page
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing Notion page’s properties and/or icon/cover and can set its archived state; returns the updated Notion page object as mirrored locally. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the update payload is malformed (e.g., non-object properties, invalid types), UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks permission to edit the page, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not shared with the integration, CONFLICT if the requested state transition is refused by Notion (e.g., attempting to modify fields that are not editable in the page’s current state), and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request.

properties.description: Notion page properties payload to update (Notion API shape).

archived.description: Whether the page should be archived in Notion.

icon.description: Notion icon object to set on the page (Notion API shape).

cover.description: Notion cover object to set on the page (Notion API shape).

tool_schemas.name: archive_page
tool_schemas.description: Archives (sets archived=true) for the specified Notion page and returns the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if notion_page_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot edit the page, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not shared with the integration, CONFLICT if the page is already archived or cannot be archived due to its current state, and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request.

tool_schemas.name: restore_page
tool_schemas.description: Restores an archived Notion page (sets archived=false) and returns the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if notion_page_id is missing/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot edit the page, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not shared with the integration, CONFLICT if the page is not archived or cannot be restored due to its current state, and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request.

tool_schemas.name: get_page_property
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single page property item for the given page and property identifier and returns the property value; for properties that are paginated (e.g., relation/rollup-style lists), results are returned as a page of items controlled by page_size (1–100) and start_cursor, with a next-cursor when more items exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if property_id/notion_page_id are missing/invalid or page_size is out of range, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration lacks access to the page/property, NOT_FOUND if the page or property does not exist (including when a property name/id cannot be resolved), and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request.

notion_page_id.description: Notion page id that owns the property.

property_id.description: Notion property id (or property name, if supported by the backend) to retrieve.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for property items that return a list.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return for paginated property values.

tool_schemas.name: add_todo
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Todo backed by a Notion database page in the specified local todos database, setting the provided fields (title required; description/due_at/priority/tags/assignees optional) and returns the created todo record (including its backing Notion page linkage). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if due_at is not ISO-8601 date-time, or if priority is not one of the supported values; UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, NOT_FOUND if database_id does not exist or is not a Todo-backed database in this service, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot create pages in the underlying Notion database, CONFLICT if the database is in a state that does not accept new todos (e.g., archived/disabled), and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to use for the Notion request and local todo creation.

database_id.description: Local database id that backs the Todo model.

tags.description: Optional list of tags for the todo.

assignees.description: Optional list of assignee identifiers (as stored by this backend).

tool_schemas.name: search_todos
tool_schemas.description: Searches todos visible to the given integration with optional database scoping, free-text query, structured filter, and sort; returns up to limit (1–100) todos plus an opaque cursor for the next page when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, sort contains unsupported fields/directions, or filter fields have invalid types; UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, NOT_FOUND if a provided database_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot access the requested database’s todos, and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to scope the todo search.

database_id.description: Optional local database id to restrict results to one todos database.

query.description: Free-text query applied to todo title/description (backend-defined behavior).

due_before.description: Return todos with due_at before this timestamp.

due_after.description: Return todos with due_at after this timestamp.

tags.description: Return todos that match the given tags (backend-defined matching).

assignees.description: Return todos that match the given assignees (backend-defined matching).

sort.description: Sort instructions for the result set.

limit.description: Maximum number of todos to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: create_database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Notion database under the specified parent page with the provided title and schema, and returns the created database object as mirrored locally. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if title/schema are missing or schema is not a valid object, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot create databases under the parent page, NOT_FOUND if the parent page does not exist or is not shared with the integration, CONFLICT if the requested schema cannot be created due to incompatible property definitions, and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

parent_page_notion_id.description: Notion page id of the parent page where the database will be created.

title.description: Plaintext title for the new database.

schema.description: Notion database properties/schema object to create (passed through to Notion).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_database(integration_id, parent_page_notion_id, title, schema, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0066000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0066000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        import os
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        b = os.urandom(16)
        num = int.from_bytes(b, "big")
        s = ""
        for _ in range(17):
            num, r = divmod(num, 32)
            s = alphabet[r] + s
        return prefix + s

    def _log(success, integration_id_val, notion_endpoint=None, notion_http_status=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, request_payload=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        logs.append({
            "id": _gen_id("nia_req_"),
            "integration_id": integration_id_val if isinstance(integration_id_val, str) else "",
            "tool_name": "create_database",
            "request_payload": request_payload,
            "notion_endpoint": notion_endpoint,
            "notion_http_status": notion_http_status,
            "success": bool(success),
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "duration_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    # validate inputs (pattern in tool is stricter {17} but accept {17,} to match other tools/dataset)
    if not isinstance(integration_id, str) or not re.match(r"^nia_int_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{17,}$", integration_id):
        _log(False, integration_id if isinstance(integration_id, str) else "", error_code="validation_error",
             error_message="integration_id is missing or malformed",
             request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "integration_id is missing or malformed")
    if not isinstance(parent_page_notion_id, str) or not parent_page_notion_id.strip():
        _log(False, integration_id, error_code="validation_error", error_message="parent_page_notion_id is missing or invalid",
             request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "parent_page_notion_id is missing or invalid")
    if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
        _log(False, integration_id, error_code="validation_error", error_message="title is required and must be non-empty",
             request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title is required and must be non-empty")
    if not isinstance(schema, dict):
        _log(False, integration_id, error_code="validation_error", error_message="schema must be an object",
             request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "schema must be an object")

    integrations = _load("integrations.json")
    if isinstance(integrations, dict) and "rows" in integrations:
        integrations = []
    if not isinstance(integrations, list):
        integrations = []

    databases = _load("databases.json")
    if isinstance(databases, dict) and "rows" in databases:
        databases = []
    if not isinstance(databases, list):
        databases = []

    integ = next((r for r in integrations if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("id") == integration_id), None)
    if not integ:
        _log(False, integration_id, error_code="unauthorized", error_message="Unknown integration_id",
             request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Unknown integration_id")
    if integ.get("status") in ("disabled", "revoked"):
        _log(False, integration_id, error_code="unauthorized",
             error_message="Integration is disabled or revoked; mutating operations are not permitted",
             request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Integration is disabled or revoked; mutating operations are not permitted")

    # simulate Notion create database -> create a unique Notion database id and local mirror
    notion_database_id = _gen_id("nia_ndb_")
    # uniqueness(integration_id, notion_database_id)
    while any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get("integration_id") == integration_id and d.get("notion_database_id") == notion_database_id for d in databases):
        notion_database_id = _gen_id("nia_ndb_")

    db_row = {
        "id": _gen_id("nia_dbs_"),
        "integration_id": integration_id,
        "notion_database_id": notion_database_id,
        "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id,
        "title_plaintext": title,
        "schema": schema,
        "archived": False,
        "status": "active",
        "notion_created_time": now,
        "notion_last_edited_time": now,
        "last_synced_at": now,
        "last_sync_error": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    databases.append(db_row)
    _save("databases.json", databases)

    _log(True, integration_id, notion_endpoint="/v1/databases", notion_http_status=200,
         request_payload={"integration_id": integration_id, "parent_page_notion_id": parent_page_notion_id, "title": title})

    return {"database": db_row}

tool_schemas.name: query_database
tool_schemas.description: Query a Notion database using the selected integration and returns a single page of matching database pages; pagination is cursor-based and you pass the returned next_cursor back to fetch subsequent pages until no more results remain. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when filter/sort/pagination arguments are malformed or out of allowed bounds, UNAUTHORIZED if the integration_id is unknown/disabled, FORBIDDEN if the integration cannot read the database, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist or is not shared with the integration, and RATE_LIMITED when upstream or service quotas are exceeded.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

database_id.description: Local database mirror id to query.

filter.description: Notion-style filter object to apply to the database query.

sorts.description: List of Notion-style sort objects to apply to the database query.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return (Notion page_size semantics).

start_cursor.description: Cursor for pagination to continue from a previous query response.

tool_schemas.name: verify_connection
tool_schemas.description: Validates that the specified local integration can authenticate with the Notion API and returns the connection status plus any workspace/account metadata we can fetch for that token. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the integration_id format is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the integration record does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED if the stored Notion credentials are missing, revoked, or otherwise rejected by Notion. Raises RATE_LIMITED when the integration or Notion API quota is exceeded, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when Notion cannot be reached or returns transient upstream failures.

integration_id.description: Local integration id to verify against the Notion API.

tool_schemas.name: get_database_info
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and returns the database metadata (schema/properties, title, and sync/mirror identifiers) for a database in the integration’s workspace, resolved by either local database_id or a Notion database id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided or if an id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist in our mirror and cannot be resolved in Notion, and UNAUTHORIZED if the integration cannot access that database (missing connection, revoked token, or insufficient Notion permissions). Raises RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on transient Notion/upstream failures.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

database_id.description: Local database mirror id to fetch info for.

notion_database_id.description: Notion database id to fetch info for (alternative to database_id).

tool_schemas.name: add_content_blocks
tool_schemas.description: Creates the provided Notion block objects as children of the given parent block and returns the created blocks (including their assigned Notion ids and our mirror ids when available), inserting after after_block_notion_id when provided or appending otherwise. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the parent identifier is missing/invalid, blocks is empty, or any block payload is structurally invalid for Notion, NOT_FOUND if the parent block (or the after_block_notion_id target) cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED if the integration lacks access to the parent or cannot write in that location. Raises CONFLICT if the parent is archived/locked or otherwise refuses child insertion, RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on transient Notion/upstream failures.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

parent_block_id.description: Local parent block id to append children to.

parent_notion_block_id.description: Notion parent block id to append children to (alternative to parent_block_id).

after_block_notion_id.description: If provided, insert the new blocks after this Notion block id.

blocks.description: Array of Notion block objects to add as children.

items.description: A Notion API block object to create.

tool_schemas.name: get_block_content
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full content for a single block, resolved by local block_id or Notion block id, including the mirrored Notion block payload and current archived/sync state when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no identifier is provided or an id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the block cannot be found in our mirror and cannot be fetched from Notion, and UNAUTHORIZED if the integration cannot access the block. Raises RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on transient Notion/upstream failures.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

block_id.description: Local block mirror id to fetch.

notion_block_id.description: Notion block id to fetch (alternative to block_id).

tool_schemas.name: list_block_children
tool_schemas.description: Lists a block’s direct child blocks and returns a paged result set using Notion-style pagination (page_size up to 100, with start_cursor and a next_cursor/has_more-style continuation token in the response). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the block identifier is missing/invalid, page_size is out of range, or start_cursor is not accepted, NOT_FOUND if the parent block cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED if the integration lacks access to read the block’s children. Raises RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on transient Notion/upstream failures.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

block_id.description: Local block mirror id whose children should be listed.

notion_block_id.description: Notion block id whose children should be listed (alternative to block_id).

page_size.description: Maximum number of children to return.

start_cursor.description: Cursor for pagination to continue from a previous list response.

tool_schemas.name: update_block_content
tool_schemas.description: Updates a block’s content and/or archived state, passing the provided content payload through to Notion for the specified block_type, and returns the updated block as stored in Notion and mirrored locally. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no identifier is provided, block_type is unsupported for the given content, the content payload is invalid, or mutually incompatible updates are requested, NOT_FOUND if the block cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED if the integration cannot edit the block. Raises CONFLICT when attempting to modify an archived block (unless archiving it) or when Notion refuses the requested state transition, RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on transient Notion/upstream failures.

integration_id.description: Local integration id used to authenticate and select the Notion workspace.

block_id.description: Local block mirror id to update.

notion_block_id.description: Notion block id to update (alternative to block_id).

block_type.description: Type of the block being updated.

content.description: Notion block content payload for the given block_type (passed through to Notion).

tool_schemas.name: delete_block
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a block by local block_id or Notion block id: when archive=true we archive the block in Notion (soft delete) and return the resulting archived block state; when archive=false we remove the local mirror record when supported and return the deletion outcome. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, an id is malformed, or the requested mode is not supported for the target, NOT_FOUND if the block cannot be resolved, and UNAUTHORIZED if the integration lacks permission to delete/archive it. Raises CONFLICT if the block is already archived/deleted or is in a state Notion refuses to delete, RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion, and SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE on transient Notion/upstream failures.

integration_id.description: ID of the integration connection to use (integrations.id).

block_id.description: Local block record ID to delete/archive (blocks.id).

notion_block_id.description: Notion block ID to delete/archive (alternative to block_id).

archive.description: If true, archive the block (soft delete in Notion); if false, perform a hard delete in the local mirror when supported.
